title: 鹿柴
author: Wang Wei

translation: empty mountains, and no one in sight
only the echo of human voices
returning light slips into the deep forest
and shines again on the green moss

appreciation: Wang Wei paints a mountain so empty that the only proof of people is the echo of their voices. Then the setting sun slips through the trees and lights the moss again, a small return of warmth after the silence. The poem matters because it makes emptiness feel full rather than hollow, and it is a perfect example of his painter's eye and Zen calm.
